title: Priority claim: four parity and congruence-periodicity theorems for the order-5 and order-9 recurrences obtained from matching counts of notched 3-by-n and 4-by-n grids (Lean 4, machine-checked; AI4Math pipeline)
description: Priority deposit record (claim of record), not a full paper. Contains a 12-page claim note (LaTeX source + compiled PDF) and four Lean 4 theorems about two recurrence-defined integer sequences a3, a4 : Nat -> Int (0-indexed), whose recurrences were obtained by exact enumeration of the matchings of P_3 x P_n and P_4 x P_n with the top-right vertex deleted: (T1, a3_odd_iff) a3(n) is odd iff n mod 6 is 2 or 3; (T2, a4_odd_iff) a4(n) is odd iff n mod 5 is 0 or 2; (T3, a3_mod8_periodic) a3(n+12) congruent a3(n) modulo 8; (T4, a4_mod4_eq2_iff) a4(n) congruent 2 modulo 4 iff n mod 10 is 6. All four are checked by the Lean 4 kernel with Lean v4.34.0 and mathlib v4.34.0 (revision 5ed29652): no sorry, axioms exactly propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound, and statements byte-identical to a hash-frozen file (symmetric difference empty). The identification of the two sequences with the notched-grid matching counts is NOT formalized: it is reported at the computational-evidence layer (a column-frontier dynamic program produced the whole 24-row count table; an independent brute-force recursion over matchings was run only over the first 8 entries of the 3 x n column and the first 6 of the 4 x n column, where the two methods agree term by term; recurrence re-substitution checked up to n = 60; modular dynamic programming up to n = 600) and stated as a conjecture in the accompanying paper. Novelty is search evidence only: the structured C9 review adjudicated both main propositions as 'no occupying record found' at value tier 'new sequence / new recurrence'; the derived perfect-matching sub-count of the 3 x n notch is occupied by OEIS A001353 (with the Zucker / Castilleja School Math Club attribution recorded there) and is excluded from any novelty statement, and the 4 x n perfect-matching direction is degenerate because 4n-1 is odd. Also included: the frozen statement file, the delivered development, the toolchain pin, the audit evidence (gate key lines, axiom printout, symmetric-difference conclusion, byte-level listing verification, C9-vs-frozen checks, bibliography reachability record) and the complete C9 novelty query log including every zero-hit query. Note under CC BY 4.0, code under MIT. Produced by the AI4Math highly automated pipeline (LLM generation with Lean kernel adjudication at every gate); the human author reviewed and is responsible for all content. AI-generated artifact.
